item.title: Zūm launches fully electric school bus fleet in Branford, Connecticut
item.description: Student transportation provider Zūm will deploy a fully electric school bus fleet for Branford Public Schools in Connecticut, beginning in the 2026-27 school year. All the e-buses will feature built-in bidirectional V2G capabilities. item.title: Baltic Yachts electrifies sailing systems with Molabo’s 48-volt motors
item.description: Baltic Yachts has been integrating Molabo’s 48-volt electric motors across a range of onboard functions on its sailing yachts—from propulsion and hydraulic sail handling to energy generation. item.title: HeyCharge wins €2.5-million grant to develop its offline EV charging solution
item.description: HeyCharge, a Munich-based EV charging technology company backed by BMW i Ventures, Statkraft Ventures and Y Combinator, has been awarded a €2.5-million grant from the European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator. item.description: Danisense, which produces high-accuracy current sense transducers for demanding applications, has expanded its DN1000ID current transducer product family with the introduction of the new DN1000ID-CP02 model. item.title: UCF Research shows C-BATT’s Obsidia battery anode material swells less than graphite during lithiation
item.description: University of Central Florida (UCF) research suggests that C-BATT’s Obsidia battery anode material could help solve material swelling during cycling, which is one of the most persistent causes of failure in lithium-ion batteries. item.title: Lectron’s full EV charging adapter lineup earns UL 2252 certification
item.description: Lectron has achieved UL 2252 certification across its full range of EV charging adapters—covering NACS, CCS and J1772 in both AC and DC configurations.
